name: pier-and-stairs
caption: Capped pale posts and dark rails follow the photo. Stairs are an explicit game adaptation.
limitations: Actual exported meshes in CPU diffuse lighting; WebGL shader/performance review remains pending.

findings: Stair shoulders use terminal-post pieces, containing rail endings. Coping returns, actual tread tops and native landing are visible. Cropped bear framing is deliberate; stairs are an explicit game adaptation.
